nodes.label: GitHub Clone & Cross-Repo Merge
nodes.rationale: Clones into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs; merge-graphs tags each node in the merged graph with a repo attribute so results can be filtered by origin.

nodes.label: Monorepo Multi-Subfolder Merge
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline separately on each subfolder would clobber the same graphify-out/ directory, so each subfolder is extracted via the CLI directly (which places graphify-out/ inside the scanned path) and merged afterward with merge-graphs at the project root.
